review_basis: Manual review of all 193 unique delta titles and abstracts; selected items are the bounded subset capable of changing one or more current method-path families.

selections.reason: Training-free persistent evidence state plus conservative execution guard changes the memory/repair boundary map.
A local voice-agent topology with typed executors and adaptive recovery is direct system-architecture evidence, but not yet a validated control prior.
Active-observation failure under tool-using frontier MLLMs is a strong boundary prior for closed-loop perception.
Spoken mediation of long-horizon agents supplies task and measurement structure for interactive control.
Training-free evidence-grounded memory/skill evolution changes the external state and verification map.
Optimization-free expert routing with online statistics is a close comparator for frozen multi-expert arbitration.
Oracle gap, verifier coverage, fidelity, and harm directly constrain selection claims and provide kill measurements.
Noisy verifier and repairer modeling directly changes robust stop/repair policy synthesis.
Training-free token veto is a close white-box decoding comparator and a boundary case for access-contract sensitivity.
Budget-matched repeated trials reject a universally superior fixed harness and motivate online allocation.
Verifier false-positive behavior supplies deployment-sensitive evaluator reliability evidence.
Frozen VLM candidate generation, self-correction, and multi-criteria selection is a close system-control comparator.
